sources.snippet: ← Back to Liquid Nanos LFM2-2.6B-Transcript is designed for private, on-device meeting summarization from transcripts. It generates executive summaries, detailed summaries, action items, key decisions, and participant lists.

sources.title: The Future of Meeting Summarization: Local, Fast, Private, and Fully ...
sources.snippet: Today, we're bringing this fast, private, on-device enterprise-grade meeting summarization to everyone, with LFM2-2.6B-Transcript: a purpose-built Liquid Nano designed for long-form meeting transcripts and real operational use. No cloud dependency, no data leaving the device, and no compromise on performance.
